RESEARCH BRIEFING

21 Nov 2026

Key Themes 2027

Global Key Themes 2027

Another year of resilience in the face of volatility.

Despite all the tumult, the world economy looks on track to have expanded by 2.7% in 2026, which is in line with our forecast from last December.

For 2027, we expect a modest pick-up in world GDP growth to 3.0%, but the exact path and what it means for businesses and households will hinge on three themes.

Theme 1: The AI boom won’t turn to bust. Whether 2027 brings strong growth or something much weaker will depend on the durability of the AI boom. The recent stock market wobble probably isn’t the beginning of the end.

Theme 2: Inflation will grind lower. We expect the oil price to gradually decline to its pre-war path in 2027. But this is unlikely to trigger a dovish pivot by central banks.

Theme 3: AI will dictate the path for bond yields. The AI boom has been a key driver of this year’s rise in yields and should keep them elevated in 2027.
